# 🔍 Code Review Guidelines — Multi-Asset Trading Platform

> This guide ensures every line of code meets our standards for **determinism**, **performance**, **security**, and **auditability**.

---

## 1. Review Objectives
- ✅ Correctness — matches business and protocol requirements.
- ⚡ Performance — meets latency targets (<10µs p99 for matching loop).
- 🧵 Concurrency safety — no races, locks, or unexpected contention.
- 🛡️ Security — no secrets, unsafe crypto, or PII exposure.
- 🧩 Observability — logs, metrics, and traces are present.
- 🔁 Maintainability — code is simple, modular, and documented.

---

## 2. Hot Path Review Checklist
| Area | Review Point | Pass/Fail |
|------|---------------|-----------|
| **Memory** | No heap allocation in hot loop | ☐ |
| **Branching** | No unpredictable branches | ☐ |
| **Cache locality** | Structures are contiguous | ☐ |
| **Atomic ops** | Correct ordering semantics | ☐ |
| **Locking** | No blocking locks | ☐ |
| **Benchmark** | Criterion / Google Benchmark included | ☐ |
| **Regression** | Perf regression <2% allowed | ☐ |

---

## 3. Functional Review Checklist
| Area | Review Point | Pass/Fail |
|------|---------------|-----------|
| **Tests** | Unit + integration tests exist | ☐ |
| **Schema** | Schema backward compatibility validated | ☐ |
| **Validation** | Input sanitized, no unchecked data | ☐ |
| **Error handling** | Clear propagation, no silent failures | ☐ |
| **Resilience** | Retry, circuit breaker logic covered | ☐ |

---

## 4. Copilot / AI-assisted Code Review
- Check for label `// GENERATED BY COPILOT — REVIEWED`.
- Ensure human reviewed and annotated critical logic.
- Verify code meets latency and correctness expectations.
- Ensure test coverage includes Copilot-generated code.

---

## 5. Security Review
- Validate no secrets or credentials.
- Check use of secure crypto libs only.
- Ensure all logs redact PII / sensitive info.
- Confirm correlation IDs included for audit trail.

---

## 6. Observability & Ops
- Metrics (latency histogram, error count) updated.
- Logs structured (JSON) with proper levels.
- Traces propagated via OpenTelemetry.
- Alerts updated in dashboards if new component introduced.

---

## 7. Reviewer Actions
1. Review code & logic for determinism and compliance.
2. Run local tests & benchmarks.
3. Leave structured feedback (see below).
4. Approve only after all checklists satisfied.
